connector.name: Shipmail MCP
connector.registryDescription: Shipmail MCP server for AI agent custom-domain email inboxes with REST API and webhooks.
connector.summary: Hosted at shipmail.to over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package shipmail-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shipmail-to account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <Shipmail API key> (sm_live_...). Create one at https://shipmail.to/docs/quick-start.

env.name: SHIPMAIL_API_KEY
env.description: Your Shipmail API key (sm_live_...). Create one at https://shipmail.to/docs/quick-start.
